intro: An operations manager resume that shows the operation you ran, the people in it, and the cost, speed and quality you improved.
tips: Give scale: sites, staff, volume, budget.
Show improvements in cost, speed, quality or safety, with numbers.
Mention the systems and methods you introduced.

basics.name: Carlos Mendoza
basics.label: Operations Manager
basics.summary: Operations manager with nine years in manufacturing and distribution. I run calm, safe operations and keep improving them: last year we shipped 15% more with the same team.

work.name: Electromex
highlights: Run production, quality and maintenance for a plant making 2 million units a year.
Raised on-time delivery from 88% to 97% with daily planning meetings and lean methods.
Cut lost-time injuries to zero over 18 months.

work.name: DistriNorte
highlights: Managed a warehouse shipping 8,000 orders a day.
Introduced barcode scanning, cutting picking errors by 80%.
